name: CLI tools
summary: Tools are exposed to the model as command-line programs that it runs in a shell, instead of as MCP servers or function schemas. The model passes arguments on the command line and reads the text output. Meta describes the built-in connectors of its Muse agent as CLIs that run inside the agent's sandbox, with written instructions on how to use each one.
how: Package each tool or connector as a command-line program
Install it in the environment where the agent has a shell
Describe how to call it in instructions the agent can read
The agent runs the command and reads its output
facts: Meta Muse (built-in connectors run as CLIs)
Needs a shell or sandbox, but reuses existing CLIs without a protocol layer
goodFor: Agents that already run in a sandbox with a shell
Services that ship their own CLI
watchOut: Each command runs with the shell's privileges unless sandboxed
Help text written for humans may not tell the model enough
